item.title: Iranian man, Romanian woman charged after allegedly trying to enter UK nuclear missile base, officials say
item.summary: An Iranian man and Romanian woman have been charged after allegedly trying to enter HM Naval Base Clyde, the U.K.'s nuclear submarine base in Scotland.

item.title: Iranian student warns 'barbaric' regime is taking nation 'hostage,' executing civilians to end unrest
item.summary: Iranian activist Mooné Rahimi claimed the regime is using executions and arrests as fear tactics, holding the nation "hostage" as global tensions rise.

item.title: Thune, GOP blast Dems in DHS standoff as Lankford says they fear ICE over Iran
item.summary: Sen. James Lankford, R-Okla., accused Senate Democrats of being afraid of ICE than Iran as the DHS shutdown hit its 36th day, as Republicans again offered another compromise deal to reopen.

item.title: Oscars 'didn't care' enough about ICE, Iran politics, Hollywood Reporter laments
item.summary: Hollywood Reporter's Steven Zeitchik accused celebrities of not caring enough to bring up more political issues during the Academy Awards Sunday night.

item.title: Former Clinton aide Paul Begala warns Democratic Party has become a ‘faculty lounge’ of intellectual elitism
item.summary: Democratic strategist Paul Begala says his party has become a 'faculty lounge,' criticizing elitism and sanitized language like calling prisoners 'justice involved.'

item.title: Schumer gambit fails as DHS shutdown hits 36 days and airport lines grow
item.summary: Senate Democrats' bid to pass a standalone TSA funding bill failed after Senate Republicans blocked the vote, as agents continue working without pay during the DHS shutdown.

item.title: UCF center scores on own basket in crushing blunder during team's first round loss to UCLA
item.summary: UCLA beat UCF 75-71, aided by UCF's John Bol accidentally scoring on his own basket. They advanced to face UConn in the Round of 32.

item.title: Tigers top prospect goes viral for unfiltered reaction to Pirates' Seth Hernandez's 102 mph heater
item.summary: Detroit Tigers top prospect Max Clark had a priceless reaction to a 102.4 mph fastball from Pittsburgh Pirates prospect Seth Hernandez in their 8-7 Spring Breakout loss.

item.title: Giants' Cam Skattebo claims CTE is not real and believes asthma is 'fake': 'It's an excuse'
item.summary: New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo, known for his hard-nosed style, said CTE is not real, but rather, "an excuse," while adding asthma is "fake."

item.title: March Madness perfect bracket count drops to just over 200 out of 36 million after opening round
item.summary: Kentucky's overtime win over Santa Clara was the biggest March Madness bracket buster of Friday, leaving just 224 perfect brackets heading into the second round.
